entities.summary: Hassan II was a performers & entertainers in Rabat (1929-07-09, Rabat – 1999-07-23) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
